cache.scope_match: Binary Unicode token cosine of query vs visible built_for/scope
cache.refresh: Cold/mismatching scope or pending arrivals; this is an eager change rule, not semantic novelty detection.
cache.originals: Typed original_source request triggers actual bound READs ranked by query/node lexical overlap.
cache.limitation: 35 refresh choices include cold starts and scope/arrival checks; do not attribute all35 to new-source necessity.

mempursuit.implementation: Unmodified standalone mempursuit.select, NumPy backend, adaptive stopping with upstream defaults, budget=min(4,candidates).
mempursuit.scope: Selector adaptation only; no Mem0 services, storage or full-paper replication.
mempursuit.acquisition: Largest offered request search, then selected original candidate READs in pursuit order; unselected legal actions retained.
mempursuit.embeddings: Existing metered bge-m3 at127.0.0.1:7861, complete candidate projection, raw-text vector reuse; no fingerprints.
mempursuit.cost: Provider embedding tokens plus original-ledger memory_control_mempursuit_pool CPU/wall. Retrieval and whole-flow costs remain separate.
mempursuit.diagnostic_limit: Full-candidate embedding exposure must be disclosed; use same candidate vectors for a matched selector diagnostic before claiming pure selection-algorithm benefit.
